title: Music as a Language: Victor Wooten at TEDxGabriolaIsland
summary: Bassist Victor Wooten argues that music should be learned the way children learn their first language: by immersion and play, without early correction or rigid academic instruction. He draws on how babies pick up speech from the people around them.
why: HN commenters point to it when discussing how to teach children or beginners, as a language-like alternative to formal instruction.

quote.text: Victor Wooten gave an outstanding TED talk[1] on this topic[2]
